description: Security incidents in the NEAR ecosystem from DefiLlama's hacks dataset, newest first: date, amount lost and returned, technique, chains and source. "near" are hacks on NEAR or Aurora or of NEAR protocols (NEAR Intents, 2026-10-01, is filed under BSC by DefiLlama and counted here); "related" are NEAR Catalog projects hacked on another chain. Use before integrating a protocol, or for "has X been exploited".

query.description: Text in the name, technique or description, e.g. "oracle".

name: list_incidents
